notes.title: 🍄 Time Survivors: Release Date Announcement 🍄
notes.notes:
Hey fellow gamers,
We're just weeks away from a big day for us – the launch of Time Survivors on January 15, 2024.

Mark Your Calendars: January 15th, 2024!

The past 13 months have been a wild ride of coding marathons, intense playtests, and lively discussions – all fueled by our passion as a three-person indie team.

Time Survivors is more than a game; it's our heart and soul poured into pixels. We're thrilled to share it with you on Windows PC for $4.99. Plus, as a thank you to our early supporters, enjoy a 20% off launch discount.

[previewyoutube=jScUZqv9Flc;full][/previewyoutube]A glimpse of the new Ice Age stage - still WiP! Can you spot the character - a troubled painter with a cap?

Get ready for a content-rich experience: 5 stages, 12 historical characters with unique skills, 93 different enemies, 50+ weapons and items, along with Cursed Relics, unlockables, and hidden gems to uncover.

Time Survivors demo and Chapter 0 players: your progress will carry over to the full game – pick up right where you left off!

We've poured our hearts into Time Survivors, hoping to give you a game that's both challenging and a blast to play. We can’t wait for you to dive into the different eras, unravel the story, and maybe even find yourself attached to our quirky cast of characters.

So don't forget to wishlist Time Survivors and follow us
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2211390/Time_Survivors/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217851/f54a6a79d0130e64d471a325b9a319f759994f1f.png
Every wishlist, every share, and every bit of support means the world to us and goes a long way in helping our little indie dream grow.

Thank you for being part of this incredible journey. We can't wait to see you on the other side of time!

Cheers,
- Cris, DDT, Lele (Lunar Chili team) 🕒✨

notes.title: 🔥 Release Date Reveal 🔥
notes.notes:
Embark on a time-traveling adventure in Time Survivors: Chapter 0, arriving on September 18th!

"The Most Historically Inaccurate Roguelike Ever Made" (our game 😊) offers a rogue-like bullet hell experience, starring iconic historical figures like Abe Lincoln, Tesla, Cleopatra, and more. 

Each character boasts a one-of-a-kind ability that transforms every playthrough. For example, here's Nikola Tesla's electrifying electrodes, to create shocking paths that zap your enemies.

[previewyoutube=zKJ3ooa92Xk;full][/previewyoutube]

Meanwhile, Oda Nobunaga can morph into a flying ninja robot, and Abe Lincoln can summon defensive barriers crafted from cherry trees. With 8 characters in Chapter 0, each wielding their own distinctive ability, we believe there's plenty to explore.

But that's not all! We've also introduced a tree-based meta progression system. As a small indie team, we've poured our hearts into this feature, allowing you to unlock and enhance characters, abilities, weapons, items, and stages by using resources like Guardian Hearts, Damascus Steel and Time Crystals.

Tailor your progression to your playstyle, strategically allocating resources to craft your unique build.

[previewyoutube=RfX-EhPE9C8;full][/previewyoutube]

Join our Discord community to connect directly with us, share your thoughts, and offer suggestions. We're committed to continuous improvement and growth, and your input means the world to us.

We're working hard to finalize the last details. In just 12 days, the game will be released, and you'll have the chance to dive into the story of Time Survivors: Chapter 0. Wishlist the game now to stay in the loop.

Warm regards,
- Cris, DDT, Lele (Lunar Chili Team)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455500/Time_Survivors_Chapter_0/
